caption:
Global Metadata: A dark, despairing wordless lament, 58 BPM, C minor, a bleak and grief-stricken instrumental. Emotional arc: heavy, hopeless, suffocating sorrow that never resolves — a slow descent into grief, ending on a hollow, weary note. Production: low, muffled, dense, darkened mix, no brightness.

Vocal Details: A single voice only, an adult male baritone humming wordlessly, a low, gravelly, shadowed 'mm' and 'ohh', ragged and hollow with pain. The hum is strained and mournful, carrying quiet despair. Never upbeat.

Arrangement: Intro, a lone low cello bow over a droning low organ, gray and oppressive. Body, the male hum sinks low and slow over dragging minor strings, a deep muffled drum heartbeat, and low piano notes, grief-stricken. Ending, everything thins to a single hollow cello note and the voice fades into bleak silence.
lyrics:
[Intro]
Low cello, dark drone, gray

[Body]
mm... ohh... mm... ohh...
aah... mm... ohh...

[End]
lonely cello, bleak silence
